issues.what: Police seize Bashir's torch in Chapter 2 but he still has it across his lap in Chapter 3 while saying they kept it.
The Thursday-night bundle is wrapped in yesterday's paper though returns are always wrapped in that day's paper.
The display Buddha is grey schist on bare stone in Chapter 3 but plaster and marble dust in Chapter 5.
The Saturday-morning jalebi meeting with Sethi from Chapter 6 is written again as if new.
The investigating inspector is Chaudhry in Chapter 2 but Ilyas in Chapter 8 with no change explained.
The second corridor key taped inside Register Volume Four was never planted before it explains the entries.
Red numbers are 94-G-01 and 94/201 to 94/211 earlier but 411 to 421 on the 1994 receipt.
Ten returns plus the eleventh guest are unveiled as ten real figures instead of eleven.
